coordinateFrameNote: The shapefile gives coordinates in the IAU Moon 2000 geographic system; they are applied in MOON_ME as given. The difference from IAU-frame realisations is below about 100 m and is documented, not corrected.
dem: LOLA + Kaguya SLDEM2015 512 px/deg (59 m, to 20 km; LOLA LDEM_512 where |lat| > 59 deg) + LOLA LDEM_64 (474 m, to 600 km); exact spherical-Moon geometry
maskSource: SLDEM2015 59 m (to 20 km) + LOLA 474 m DEM
longTermPeriod: 2009-01-01 + 18.6 yr, hourly, 2 m observer, any part of disk, lunar eclipses included
